rationale: The agent appears to have executed an exchange action (exchange_delivered_order_items for both items) but there is no evidence of seeking or receiving user confirmation prior to the order-changing write, which violates the stated policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. While the tools list suggests the agent authenticated the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip and get_user_details) and accessed order/product details, there is no confirmation step shown, no verification that the chosen replacements match the user’s preferences, and no final, correct summary of what was changed. The closing message is a generic sign-off without details. Acting without explicit confirmation fails the pass bar.
